task.instruction: Identify the top scorer in the NBA from the latest completed game and note down the points scored, the team they play for, and their position on the team.

final_answer:
The top scorer was Scottie Barnes of the Toronto Raptors, with 41 points. His position is Forward (F), and he wears #4.

He scored the 41 in the Orlando Magic's 121-114 win over the Raptors, an NBA Cup group play game at Scotiabank Arena. He shot 19-of-34 from the field and added 5 rebounds and 5 assists. Desmond Bane was the Magic's top scorer with 28.

One caveat: I chose this game because it is the last final listed on ESPN's scoreboard, and its box score shows a 7:30 AM tip-off on 31 Oct. Other games on that day's scoreboard were also final, and I didn't compare their finish times. If a different game finished later, the answer could change.

judge.rationale: ESPN scoreboard shows Magic-Raptors as the last listed final, and ESPN player page supports Barnes had 41 PTS for Raptors and position F.

final_page.title: Scottie Barnes - Toronto Raptors Forward - ESPN
